name: Action Allowlist
description: Define which actions an AI agent may execute and explicitly prohibit others.
implementation_guidance: Configure allowlisted actions and test denied operations.
iso_iec_42001: A.6 AI system life cycle; A.9 Use of AI systems
eu_ai_act: Art. 14 Human oversight; Art. 15 Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity

name: Transaction Limits
description: Set thresholds for financial, customer-impacting, or irreversible actions.
implementation_guidance: Require additional approval above defined thresholds.

name: Identity and Delegated Authority
description: Verify the requesting user and scope agent authority to that user's permissions.
implementation_guidance: Bind actions to authorized principals and validate permission checks.
iso_iec_42001: A.3 Internal organization; A.9 Use of AI systems
eu_ai_act: Art. 14 Human oversight; Art. 15 Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity

name: External Action Confirmation
description: Require explicit confirmation before high-impact external messages, changes, or transactions.
implementation_guidance: Introduce confirmation checkpoints for consequential actions.

name: Agent Execution Traceability
description: Record agent tool calls, approvals, and action outcomes for investigation.
implementation_guidance: Log trace IDs and outcomes without unnecessary sensitive content.

name: Runaway Loop and Budget Limits
description: Cap how many steps, tool calls, tokens, and dollars an AI agent can spend on one task so it cannot loop or run up costs unchecked.
implementation_guidance: Set per-task limits on steps, tool calls, run time, and spend; stop the agent and alert its owner when a limit is hit.
verification_guidance: Configured limits and a test run that triggers each limit

name: Agent Memory and Context Hygiene
description: Control what an AI agent remembers between tasks and what documents, emails, or web pages it reads, so untrusted or sensitive content does not carry over.
implementation_guidance: Define what the agent may store and for how long; separate memory per user or customer; treat retrieved content as untrusted data, never as instructions.
verification_guidance: Memory policy and a test showing one user's data does not appear in another user's session
eu_ai_act: Art. 10 Data governance; Art. 15 Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity

name: Sub-Agent and Delegation Limits
description: When an AI agent hands work to other agents or tools, the receiving agent gets no more permission than the original agent, and the chain of delegation is recorded.
implementation_guidance: Pass down only the permissions each sub-task needs; limit how many levels deep delegation can go; log which agent acted on whose behalf.
verification_guidance: Delegation policy and a log showing a full delegation chain for one task

name: Named Accountable Owner
description: Assign a responsible business owner to each AI use case.
implementation_guidance: Record owner, decision authority, and escalation contact.

name: Human Approval Gates
description: Require meaningful human approval before defined consequential AI actions.
implementation_guidance: Identify approval thresholds and block execution without authorization.

name: Human Override and Shutdown
description: Provide ways to interrupt, override, or disable AI actions when necessary.
implementation_guidance: Implement kill switch or equivalent controls and rehearse intervention.

name: Escalation for Uncertain Outputs
description: Route low-confidence, ambiguous, or high-stakes cases to qualified humans.
applicable_risk: Business Impact; User Exposure; Human Oversight
implementation_guidance: Define escalation triggers and measure handling performance.

name: Decision and Accountability Record
description: Document significant AI-assisted decisions, reviewers, and approvals.
implementation_guidance: Log decision rationale and approval evidence appropriate to the use case.
iso_iec_42001: A.3 Internal organization; A.6 AI system life cycle

name: AI Disclosure to People
description: Tell people when they are interacting with an AI system or seeing AI-generated content.
implementation_guidance: Add a clear notice to AI chat interfaces and label AI-generated images, audio, video, or text published to the public.
verification_guidance: Screenshots of the notice and labels in each customer-facing channel

name: Operational Monitoring
description: Track AI errors, failures, usage anomalies, and service reliability.
implementation_guidance: Define alerts, thresholds, and response ownership.
eu_ai_act: Art. 26 Deployer obligations; Art. 72 Post-market monitoring

name: Safety and Quality Monitoring
description: Sample production outcomes for harmful, incorrect, or policy-violating behavior.
implementation_guidance: Review representative outputs and trend failure rates.
verification_guidance: Quality review records and trend report
eu_ai_act: Art. 15 Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity; Art. 72 Post-market monitoring

name: AI Incident Response
description: Establish triage, containment, escalation, and recovery procedures for AI incidents.
implementation_guidance: Add AI scenarios to incident plans and conduct a tabletop exercise.
iso_iec_42001: A.3 Internal organization; A.8 Information for interested parties
eu_ai_act: Art. 26 Deployer obligations; Art. 73 Serious incident reporting

name: Periodic Risk Reassessment
description: Reassess risk after material changes and at a defined review interval.
applicable_risk: Data Sensitivity; Business Impact; Autonomy; User Exposure; Human Oversight
implementation_guidance: Trigger reviews for model, data, tool, scope, and deployment changes.

name: Data Minimization
description: Limit collection, processing, and retention to information necessary for the approved AI purpose.
implementation_guidance: Document approved data fields, remove unnecessary inputs, and periodically review access.
verification_guidance: Approved data inventory and minimization review

name: Personal Data Handling
description: Define lawful and authorized handling of personal data across prompts, outputs, logs, and vendors.
implementation_guidance: Map personal-data flows and verify handling requirements with privacy counsel.
verification_guidance: Data flow map and privacy review

name: Retention and Deletion
description: Define and enforce retention periods and deletion processes for AI inputs, outputs, and logs.
implementation_guidance: Set retention schedules and test deletion where supported.
verification_guidance: Retention policy and deletion test records

name: Vendor Data Use Review
description: Review provider terms, training use, subprocessors, and data processing safeguards before approval.
implementation_guidance: Complete vendor review and document permitted data uses.
eu_ai_act: Art. 13 Transparency to deployers; Art. 26 Deployer obligations

name: Sensitive Data Redaction
description: Remove or mask sensitive data before AI processing where practical.
implementation_guidance: Implement redaction rules and test for leaks and over-redaction.

name: AI Data Access Restrictions
description: Limit the data each AI system can read to what its approved purpose requires, using existing data permissions.
implementation_guidance: Give each AI system read access only to approved data sources through existing permission controls; block restricted data by default.
verification_guidance: Access configuration and a test showing restricted data is not returned

name: Use Case Acceptance Criteria
description: Define measurable success, safety, and failure criteria before deployment.
applicable_risk: Business Impact; User Exposure; Human Oversight
implementation_guidance: Set task-level acceptance thresholds and test against representative cases.
eu_ai_act: Art. 9 Risk management; Art. 15 Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity

name: Representative Evaluation Set
description: Test AI against realistic, diverse, and challenging scenarios relevant to intended use.
applicable_risk: User Exposure; Business Impact; Data Sensitivity
implementation_guidance: Maintain versioned evaluation cases including edge cases.
iso_iec_42001: A.6 AI system life cycle; A.7 Data for AI systems
eu_ai_act: Art. 10 Data governance; Art. 15 Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity

name: Output Accuracy and Grounding
description: Assess factual correctness and grounding for relevant AI outputs.
applicable_risk: Business Impact; User Exposure; Human Oversight
implementation_guidance: Measure unsupported claims and introduce validation where appropriate.

name: Bias and Fairness Evaluation
description: Evaluate harmful performance differences across relevant populations or scenarios.
applicable_risk: Business Impact; User Exposure; Data Sensitivity
implementation_guidance: Define applicable fairness measures and review subgroup outcomes.
iso_iec_42001: A.5 Impact assessment; A.7 Data for AI systems

name: Regression Testing
description: Retest quality and safety after model, prompt, data, or tool changes.
implementation_guidance: Run versioned tests before production changes and compare results.

name: Role-Based Access Control
description: Grant AI platform access according to approved job roles and responsibilities.
implementation_guidance: Define roles, restrict privileged access, and review grants regularly.

name: Credential and Secret Protection
description: Keep credentials and API keys out of prompts, model outputs, and unprotected logs.
implementation_guidance: Use secrets management, rotation, and leakage detection.

name: Prompt Injection Defense
description: Test and constrain AI behavior when processing untrusted instructions or retrieved content.
implementation_guidance: Test prompt injection scenarios and enforce tool/data boundaries.
verification_guidance: Adversarial test report and mitigation evidence

name: Tool Permission Boundaries
description: Limit which tools and resources AI systems can invoke and under what conditions.
implementation_guidance: Apply scoped permissions and deny unauthorized tool actions.
iso_iec_42001: A.6 AI system life cycle; A.9 Use of AI systems

name: Environment and Change Security
description: Separate development and production access and review changes to AI configurations.
implementation_guidance: Require change approvals, versioning, and rollback procedures.
